topic: dispute an error on a credit report
core_question: How do I dispute an incorrect item on my credit report?
answer_summary: Identify which credit bureau (Equifax, Experian, or TransUnion) is reporting the error, file a dispute online or by mail with documentation supporting the correction, and the bureau must investigate and respond within about 30 days.
persona: impatient and curt; writing in full careful sentences

Which of the three major credit bureaus is reporting that charge? And do you have receipts or any documentation showing the charge was not yours?
Equifax is showing it. I have my bank statements proving I didn't authorize it. So what do I do now?
